blocks.text: Teach anywhere in the world as well as on Mars.
MOST IMPORTANTLY- You’ll be TRAINED AND PREPARED to actually TEACH.

Kashish Yoga is registered with Yoga Alliance International – benchmark of quality. Our certification entitles you to teach anywhere in the world and we believe that your graduation day isn’t an ending but the beginning of a beautiful, impactful, dynamic, & transformed YOU.
You don't need to figure everything out alone. We'll help you understand what to expect before you arrive.

children.text: Visa guidance, packing information and arrival preparation.

blocks.text: Travelling to India for the first time can feel exciting - and a little overwhelming. That's why support before and during your stay matters.
Everything you need to know about the 200 Hours YTTC program, from eligibility to logistics.
Do I need previous yoga experience?

children.text: Prior yoga experience is helpful but not required to join a Yoga Teacher Training Course (TTC). Whether you’re a beginner or have some practice, the training guides you step-by-step. The most important quality is a strong desire to learn and grow in your yoga journey.

blocks.text: Is this suitable for complete beginners?

children.text: Some beginners may have a considerable amount of yoga knowledge and follow a yogic lifestyle but may not be so advanced in asana practice. Other beginners may have great physical ability for the asana practice but may not have an understanding or knowledge of yoga as a whole. In either case, if you show great dedication and devotion to learning yoga, the training may be suitable.

children.text: The training will be for 24 days.

All out-of-India citizens require a valid visa to enter India. The appropriate visa category for tourism is the "Tourist Visa". Applying for your visa well before your intended travel date is important, as the processing times can vary.
To apply for an Indian Tourist Visa, follow these steps:

Visit the official website of the Indian Visa Online Application Centre (https://indianvisaonline.gov.in/evisa/tvoa.html) and apply for an e-tourist visa. This would be available within 4-7 working days most often.

For someone enrolling on a 200 Hour program, a 30 days visa is also good. However, someone planning to enrol in a 300 Hour program or having an intention to travel across India before or after any Yoga Teacher Training Course, should apply for a 1-year visa.
Extensions of tourist visas within India are generally not allowed.
Important: E-visa must be applied at least (latest) four days before the arrival date.

blocks.text: How do I get from Goa airport to Kashish?

children.text: Your airport shuttle pick-up is included in the package. The shuttle will run 3 times on the day of the beginning of your course at 8 AM, 12 PM and 4 PM.

Should the above not match with your time and date of arrival, then you may choose to request for a special pickup from us for 22 EUR from Madgaon Railway Station, 35 EUR additional from GOI, 65 EUR from GOX.

We are located in a very safe location in Goa. The local population are very mindful of maintaining safety for visitors to create sustainable tourism. India in general has much lower crime rates than other countries and most people have entirely positive experiences. All travellers should take the usual precautions that you would take at home and when travelling anywhere. Most people feel a lot safer and at ease in India than at home and this is often a welcome surprise. We recommend that women travel in women’s compartments in trains and we encourage students to take flights to Goa instead of busses to avoid dangerous roads. Our Training and Retreat Centre in Goa has 24 hour security and any visitors to the training Centre must pre-register before being granted access. We are extremely strict regarding security and safety of our yoga guests. We organize airport pick-ups for all of our trainees with local drivers who we know and trust. We have been using the same drivers for the last decade and they are well used to looking after our staff, yoga visitors and trainees.

Pure, vegetarian food is provided in the school. No eggs, meat or fish is allowed in the campus. Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner along with detox juices, refreshment, tea, coffee, water is provided. Sundays are off for meals giving all students an opportunity to try out local cuisines in the cafes and restaurants nearby.

blocks.text: Can I change my course date?

children.text: In case you are unable to arrive for your previously decided dates due to some reason, you can always request a shift of dates. It will be subject to availability and the discount (Early Bird if applied previously) will also be subject to the new dates selected.

Please note that no fees (whether paid in partial or full) will be refundable. In case the student decides to leave the course after the payment of the deposit or the full fees due to any reason, they will not be entitled to any refund of the fees paid.

They shall have the option to continue the course at a future date (within a period of 1 year) from where they left off. However, no requests for refunds will be entertained for the cancellation of the course at any time.

blocks.text: Can I speak to someone before booking?

children.text: Absolutely, we have several course counsellors to help you with your queries. They can also get you in touch with our teaching faculty should you need as well as Kashish alumni to help resolve your doubts with utmost satisfaction.
